verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a physical processor that the buyer owns and runs. Asking whether it can be self-hosted, as opposed to vendor-hosted, is a category error for silicon hardware. The evidence about local and air-gapped inference (GAIA, Lemonade, ONNX Runtime) shows it can run AI models on-device. That is a different question from self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
